name: XDKNet 2.5.1
body:
Android TV 2.5.1, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.1 (Emby 2.0.5.1).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## Report a problem from a title's page

A movie, show, season or episode in your library now has a **Report issue**
button on its page, next to Watchlist, Download and the other actions (under
More on narrow screens). It sends the problem to Seerr, the same as the
report on Seerr's own title page: pick video, audio, subtitles or something
else, and add a note. Reporting from an episode or a season starts on that
season and episode.

The button shows when Seerr is set up, the title is in Seerr as available,
and your Seerr account may create issues. It can be hidden or moved like the
other buttons under Details screen > Action Buttons.

The web app gets the same button with plugin 2.1.0.1 (Emby 2.0.5.1), which
carries the updated web client.

Pair with plugin 2.1.0.1 (Emby 2.0.5.1).
